patient_case.presentation: acute-onset painful scattered umbilicated papulopustules and ovoid ulcerated plaques with elevated, pink borders

clinical_context.suspicion: highly suspicious for infection due to immunocompromise

diagnostic_test.name: Tzanck smear
procedure: scraping the base of an ulcerated lesion and inner aspect of a pseudopustule with a #15 blade
contents placed on a glass slide
fixed and stained with Wright-Giemsa and Papanicolaou stains

reasoning_tree.start: Immunocompromised patient with umbilicated and ulcerated lesions

diagnostic_options.description: A viral infection known to cause painful ulcers in immunocompromised individuals.
evidence_for: Classic cytopathic effects (ballooning keratinocytes, nuclear changes)
